text:
Rina (Product): Heads-up 1 enterprise customer (Percival) asked to move up private onramp by 2 weeks and wants full model-pin + KMS. We need a quick scope cut and alignment across runtime/infra/security. Can we triage? @Ethan @Leila @Hank @Priya

Priya (Sales): Percival is willing to sign a month-long pilot with high-touch support but they need staging available in 10 business days. Theyre firm on audit logs + customer-managed keys.

Ethan (Eng Runtime): On runtime side: model-pin + warmed KV cache are the heavy lift. Prewarm templates exist but need verification for their sequence length distribution. Also need a fallback strategy if pin fails.

Marco (Solutions): Customer will accept a reduced feature set for pilot: no streaming, single-turn inference, and batched embeddings disabled. That should ease throughput constraints.

Leila (Infra PM): Capacity-wise, we can provision a private cluster but GPU quota lead time is 72h. If Sales files a formal request and we get budget signoff, we can push to 48h via cloud support. Need expected qps and peak concurrency.

Rina (Product): Marco will share the trimmed route list and traffic profile by EOD. This is critical to size infra correctly.

Hank (Security): KMS checklist: IAM bindings, key-usage audit, HSM integration where required, and key-rotation policy. I need to see the exact service account principals that will access the KMS. Also propose a scoped pen test on the staging endpoints (2 days).

Ethan (Eng Runtime): Canary plan proposal: start with 5% traffic to private, 95% to hosted-safe. Monitor p95 latency and error-rate. If p95 > 250ms or errors spike > 1.5x baseline, automatic rollback for canary. Need Product to confirm acceptable thresholds.

Rina (Product): For pilot we accept canary p95 threshold 250ms and error multiplier 1.5x. Keep fallback to hosted-mini. Customer must opt-in to fallback.

Leila (Infra PM): We'll provide a dashboard scaffold with per-route p95, token-distribution, and GPU utilization. Who will own the dashboard after handoff?

Marco (Solutions): Solutions will own runbook for customer-facing incident flows; Infra should own infra metrics.

Hank (Security): Also require KMS audit log retention 50 days and export to their SIEM (S3 + Kinesis). Need to verify export path during staging.

Priya (Sales): Customer will provide their SIEM endpoint details once contracts are signed. We should not block pilot on SIEM before staging but KMS and audit must be enabled.

Ethan (Eng Runtime): Action items: I'll fork prewarm runbook, add sequence-length sanity, and add fallback config (PR ETA: 36h). Need list of routes + sample seq lengths.

Leila (Infra PM): Action items: request GPU quota today, prepare cluster template, and instantiate dashboard scaffold once routes are shared. ETA: quota request submitted today; cluster template in 48h.

Hank (Security): Action items: draft KMS checklist + required IAM bindings; schedule scoped pen test (2d) and confirm SIEM export options. ETA: checklist in 24h.

Priya (Sales): I'll get the contract signed and push cloud quota escalation request. Also collecting the customer's acceptance for the reduced feature set.

Rina (Product): Summarized owners and timeline:

- Runtime (Ethan): prewarm + fallback PR (36h)
- Infra (Leila): quota + cluster template + dashboard scaffold (48h)
- Security (Hank): KMS checklist + pen test slot (24-48h)
- Solutions (Marco): trimmed route list + runbook (EOD)
- Sales (Priya): contract + quota escalation (today)

```
- [ ] Marco: post trimmed route list + sample seq lengths (by EOD)
- [ ] Priya: finalize contract + open quota escalation (today)
- [ ] Ethan: runbook PR with fallback (36h)
- [ ] Leila: submit quota request + cluster template (48h)
- [ ] Hank: KMS checklist + pen test scheduling (24-48h)
```
